aboutH2: Into Action Recovery Abbotsford: Men's Recovery at The Acreage
intro: Into Action Recovery Abbotsford is Into Action's Fraser Valley site, a rural property on Satchell Street in west Abbotsford that the centre calls The Acreage. It houses men in the residential First Stage program and men in transitional Second Stage housing, so a resident can move from one to the other without changing towns.

Its published photos show more shared space than a typical family house, including a full gym, a dedicated group room and a covered patio. It is registered with the province as a supportive recovery residence.

pillars.title: Country Quiet Between Aldergrove and Abbotsford
pillars.body: Satchell Street is in the rural west end of Abbotsford, among farms and acreages between Aldergrove and the city centre. The building has a covered patio with outdoor sofas, and staff take residents out for hikes and walks in the Fraser Valley as well as to meetings and errands in town.

pillars.title: Groups, Counselling and Steps, Every Day
pillars.body: First Stage men follow a full daily schedule in the group room: educational groups on addiction and wellness, process groups where they talk through what is happening, and one-to-one counselling. Into Action draws on CBT, DBT, SMART Recovery and the Twelve Steps, and participation is mandatory. Fitness is part of the daily routine, and one of Into Action's support workers is a personal trainer.

pillars.title: Transitional Housing on the Same Property
pillars.body: Into Action describes Abbotsford as recovery and transitional housing, which means men can finish First Stage and stay on in Second Stage. Second Stage typically runs 30 days or more with no fixed limit. Residents keep a curfew, do chores, attend daily support meetings and weekly on-site counselling, and start back at work or school.

overviewH2: Into Action Recovery Abbotsford: Centre Overview
overview: Abbotsford is a good fit for men who want space away from the city and expect to need more than a single 60-day stay. It treats alcohol and drug addiction only, without medical staff, so detox and any psychiatric or prescribing care happen outside the program.

location.heading: Into Action Recovery Abbotsford in Abbotsford, British Columbia
location.intro: The Acreage is on Satchell Street in rural west Abbotsford, in the Fraser Valley between Aldergrove and the city centre. Downtown Vancouver is about an hour away by car on Highway 1, Surrey about 35 minutes, Langley around 20 minutes, central Abbotsford roughly 15 minutes and Chilliwack about 35 minutes further east.

faqIntro: Answers come from Into Action's own website, BC's Assisted Living Registry and public listings. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: What is The Acreage in Abbotsford?
faqs.a: The Acreage is Into Action Recovery's rural site at 6705 Satchell Street in west Abbotsford. BC's Assisted Living Registry lists it as Into Action Recovery Acreage, a registered supportive recovery residence, registration SU2024-000001, in Fraser Health.

faqs.q: What kind of program runs in Abbotsford?
faqs.a: Into Action describes multi-level residential programming here, with recovery housing and transitional housing for men. First Stage is a structured live-in program of at least 60 days, and Second Stage is a sober transitional stay of 30 days or more.

faqs.q: How much does Into Action Recovery Abbotsford cost?
faqs.a: Into Action does not publish a price for Abbotsford, and recovery.com shows no estimate for this house. It is a private-pay program, and admissions gives the full cost and payment options on the first call.

faqs.q: What facilities does the Abbotsford house have?
faqs.a: The photos Into Action has published show a full gym with power racks and cable machines, a group room, a large lounge, a dining room with high tables, a coffee counter, single and shared bedrooms and a covered patio. recovery.com also lists air-conditioned rooms and outdoor space.

faqs.q: Does Into Action Recovery Abbotsford do detox?
faqs.a: No. It is a non-medical supportive recovery residence with no doctors or nurses on site. Men who need withdrawal management complete detox elsewhere first, and Into Action's intake team can help arrange it.

faqs.q: How far is Abbotsford from Vancouver?
faqs.a: About an hour by car along Highway 1. The house is in rural west Abbotsford, roughly 15 minutes from the city centre, 20 minutes from Langley and 35 minutes from Chilliwack. Admissions coordinates arrival and travel if needed.

faqs.q: How long do men stay in Abbotsford?
faqs.a: First Stage runs at least 60 days and can be extended. Into Action's other pages mention 30, 60 and 90-day options, and recovery.com lists 30 to 90 days. Second Stage, if you choose it, usually adds 30 days or more.

faqs.q: Is the Abbotsford program only for men?
faqs.a: Yes. Into Action has served only adult men since it opened in 2012, at every location.

faqs.q: Can I bring my own food or supplements?
faqs.a: Yes. Into Action lets residents bring snacks and protein powder, with a resident fridge and dry-goods storage. Snacks are also provided at all hours.

faqs.q: Can I work while living at the Abbotsford house?
faqs.a: Not during First Stage, which is a full-time program. In Second Stage, men can work, go to school or take part in community activities while they keep a curfew, do daily chores and go to support meetings.
